name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: Collapsible shows and hides a block of content when its trigger is clicked. Keep the state inside with defaultOpen or control it from outside with open and onOpenChange. Height animates through interpolate-size, and the closed panel gets hidden="until-found", so in-page search opens it on its own. The trigger accepts asChild and sets aria-expanded and aria-controls for you.
